item.itunes:title: Why does 850nm infrared night vision fail Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) court evidence standards?
item.itunes:author: Gary Pearce (ADI Communications)
item.description: Official ADI Communications Technical Trade Breakdown by Gary Pearce (25+ Years Hands-On Physical Security & Telecoms Engineer, Direct Mobile: 07860 244 274, £10M Public Liability Insurance). BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT (BLUF): Why do police reject CCTV footage when an intruder's face is completely washed out by infrared glare? I'm Gary Pearce, lead security engineer at ADI Communications, with over twenty-five years of hands-on Yorkshire trade experience. Standard eight-hundred-and-fifty nanometre infrared reflects off facial skin, creating severe overexposure and wiping out crucial colour characteristics. Under British Standard BS EN 62676-4, court prosecution requires full facial identification. We install Hikvision ColorVu cameras with F1.0 super-apertures that capture twenty-four-seven full colour in pitch darkness. For advice on police-admissible CCTV, call me on 07860 244 274. Technical Standards & Hardware: - BS EN 62676-4 • CPS Evidence Guidelines • F1.0 Super-Aperture • Full-Colour Night Vision - Fitted with CAI-benchmarked equipment and double-screened WF100 cable (Gary Pearce / ADI Communications are NOT CAI members). - 9.98/10 Rating across 84+ verified client reviews. item.description: Official ADI Communications Technical Trade Breakdown by Gary Pearce (25+ Years Hands-On Physical Security & Telecoms Engineer, Direct Mobile: 07860 244 274, £10M Public Liability Insurance). BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT (BLUF): Will drilling heavy anchor bolts into your chimney stack cause structural cracks and roof leaks during winter storms? I'm Gary Pearce, lead telecoms engineer at ADI Communications, with over twenty-five years of UK field experience. Drilling into Victorian lime-mortar chimneys causes brick spalling and water penetration. We secure rectangular Starlink Gen 3 dishes using heavy-duty non-drill stainless twin-wire lashing cradles with corner mitre protectors, rated for ninety-mile-per-hour Pennine winter gales. For safe chimney installations across Yorkshire and Lancashire, call Gary on 07860 244 274. Technical Standards & Hardware: - Eurocode 1 (BS EN 1991-1-4) • Twin-Wire Stainless Lashing • Lime Mortar Preservation • 90mph Gale Rating - Fitted with CAI-benchmarked equipment and double-screened WF100 cable (Gary Pearce / ADI Communications are NOT CAI members). - 9.98/10 Rating across 84+ verified client reviews.
